primary_statistical_unit: 15 splits; 3 STR seeds aggregated within split
stable_error_primary: three seeds aggregated first within each of four validation appearances; error rate >=0.75 stable-error, <=0.25 stable-correct
score_orientation: DD positive; STR score=final_logits[1]-final_logits[0]; H1 probability_dd logit
residual_target: H1 train-z-logit minus STR train-z-logit; train-only means and scales
representation: activity_raw flatten, subject_embedding, structured_embedding, concatenated subject+structured; score-only baseline
readout: train-only StandardScaler, fixed PCA-16 randomized SVD seed 0, Ridge alpha=1
negative_control: class-conditional permutation of train residual target only
H1_pair_category_source: unclipped formal H1 probability_dd; exact RGD-01 category match verified for all 100695 seed-pair instances
H1_residual_target_source: train-only H1 probability clipped to [1e-8,1-1e-8] before logit, matching RGD-01
BA_threshold: corrected score >= 0 on STR original DD-minus-PD logit scale; descriptive, no validation threshold tuning
all_pair_net_gain: all originally STR-wrong pairs recovered minus all originally STR-correct pairs newly broken; exactly equals AUROC delta times pair count
targeted_net_gain: recovered H1-rescue pairs minus all originally STR-correct pairs newly broken
negative_control_targets: within inner-train PD and DD groups independently permuted; validation unchanged
pair_level_independence: pairs are decomposition only; 3 seeds averaged within split, 15 splits primary
